default/31628.htm.text: Mist's Granddaughter Lilly: I don't understand you at all, Grandpa! Why do you like hot water so much? Grandpa! I'm talking to you! I want some Ice Cream! Or a popcicle! You promised! You said you'd make it for me! Make it for me or I'll never speak to you again!
